title: Miami woman faces foreclosure over disputed $55,650 lien
summary_full: Angelica Martinez bought her Miami home in 2019 after a thorough title search.  City inspectors found unpermitted work on her property during a 2024 inspection.  Martinez disputes responsibility for fence and driveway work performed before her purchase.  A $55,650 lien was placed on her property after alleged non-compliance with city orders.  She awaits a mitigation hearing to resolve the ongoing dispute over the lien.
